title: Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay Delivery and Posting Timetable
content:
Payments operations timetable for Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay. Top-ups, data bundles and electricity tokens are delivered by the operator within a number of minutes; bill payments are sent to the biller against a daily cutoff in US Central time and post within a number of Paloma business days.

| Product | Delivery time after submission | Posting time at the biller | Latest submission time to the biller (US Central) | Processed on weekends and holidays | Automatic re-sends after a technical failure | Interval between automatic re-sends |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paloma Airtime Top-Up | within 5 minutes | not applicable (0) | around the clock, every day | yes | 3 | 5 minutes |
| Paloma Data Bundle | within 5 minutes | not applicable (0) | around the clock, every day | yes | 3 | 5 minutes |
| Paloma Electricity Token | within 15 minutes | not applicable (0) | around the clock, every day | yes | 2 | 10 minutes |
| Paloma Bill Pay Utilities | not applicable (0) | within 2 Paloma business days | 14:00 on a business day | no | 1 | 60 minutes |
| Paloma Bill Pay Television | not applicable (0) | within 1 Paloma business day | 16:00 on a business day | yes | 1 | 60 minutes |
| Paloma Bill Pay School Fees | not applicable (0) | within 3 Paloma business days | 13:00 on a business day | no | 1 | 60 minutes |

## Notes

- A delivery time of 0 minutes means that a delivery time in minutes does not apply to the product; a posting time of 0 business days means that posting in business days does not apply to the product.
- "Around the clock, every day" means the product has no daily submission cutoff.
- The re-send columns describe automatic re-sends after a technical failure, made before the order is failed; they are separate from any retry the customer asks for.

## Reading the timetable

- Paloma Bill Pay School Fees has the earliest daily cutoff, 13:00 US Central, and the longest posting time, 3 Paloma business days.
- Paloma Bill Pay Television is the only bill product processed on weekends and holidays.
- Hypothetical: a Paloma Electricity Token order that meets a technical failure can be re-sent automatically up to 2 times, 10 minutes apart, before it is failed.
